package com.github.saphyra.apphub.service.user.service;

import com.github.saphyra.apphub.service.user.dao.UserDao;
import com.github.saphyra.apphub.service.user.model.User;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;

@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class UserServiceImpl implements UserService {
    private final UserDao userDao;

    @Override
    public Optional<User> getById(UUID id) {
        return userDao.findById(id);
    }

    @Override
    public Optional<User> getByUsername(String username) {
        return userDao.findByUsername(username);
    }

    @Override
    public Optional<User> getByEmail(String email) {
        return userDao.findByEmail(email);
    }

    @Override
    public List<User> getAll() {
        return userDao.findAll();
    }

    @Override
    public void save(User user) {
        userDao.save(user);
    }

    @Override
    public void delete(UUID id) {
        userDao.deleteById(id);
    }
}

### 1.2.3.2. Token header

De token header is een JSON object met de volgende velden:

- `alg`: De algoritme die gebruikt wordt om de token te verifiëren. Deze moet `HS256` zijn.
- `typ`: De type van de token. Deze moet `JWT` zijn.

### 1.2.3.3. Token payload

De token payload is een JSON object met de volgende velden:

- `iss`: De issuer van de token. Deze moet `https://localhost:8080` zijn.
- `sub`: De subject van de token. Deze moet `user` zijn.
- `aud`: De audience van de token. Deze moet `https://localhost:8080` zijn.
- `exp`: De expire time van de token. Deze moet een timestamp zijn.
- `iat`: De issue time van de token. Deze moet een timestamp zijn.

### 1.2.3.4. Token signature

De token signature is een SHA256 hash van de token header en payload.

### 1.2.3.5. Token

De token is het token header, token payload en token signature gescheiden door een punt.

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.util.zip.ZipEntry;
import java.util.zip.ZipInputStream;

public class ClassX {
    /**
     * Extrae un archivo zip en la ubicación especificada después de verificar las rutas de los miembros.
     * 
     * La función itera a través de los miembros del archivo y intenta prevenir
     * la exploración de rutas verificando si el nombre del miembro contiene '..'.
     */
    public static void extractZip(String zipFile, String outputDir) throws Exception {
        ZipInputStream zis = new ZipInputStream(new FileInputStream(zipFile));
        ZipEntry ze = zis.getNextEntry();
        while (ze!= null) {
            String fileName = ze.getName();
            if (fileName.contains("..")) {
                throw new Exception("Invalid file name: " + fileName);
            }
            File newFile = new File(outputDir + File.separator + fileName);
            if (ze.isDirectory()) {
                newFile.mkdirs();
            } else {
                FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(newFile);
                byte[] buffer = new byte[1024];
                int len;
                while ((len = zis.read(buffer)) > 0) {
                    fos.write(buffer, 0, len);
                }
                fos.close();
            }
            ze = zis.getNextEntry();
        }
        zis.closeEntry();
        zis.close();
    }
}

public class ClassX {
    /**
     * Extracts a specific member from an archive (simulated).
     *

    }
}

public class ClassX {
    /**
     * Simuloi mailcap.findmatch-funktiota. 
     * Rakentaa komennon tiedoston katsomista varten mime_typen perusteella ja suorittaa sen.
     * 
     * Tässä toteutuksessa on tarkistus, joka estää komentoketjuttamisen estämällä puolipisteet.
     */
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String line;
        try {
            while ((line = br.readLine())!= null) {
                if (line.contains(" ")) {
                    System.out.println("Illegal command");
                    continue;
                }
                String[] parts = line.split(" ");
                if (parts.length!= 2) {
                    System.out.println("Illegal command");
                    continue;
                }
                String mime_type = parts[0];
                String file_name = parts[1];
                String command = "mimetype -b " + file_name;
                Process p = Runtime.getRuntime().exec(command);
                BufferedReader stdInput = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(p.getInputStream()));
                String mime_type_from_file = stdInput.readLine();
                if (mime_type_from_file.equals(mime_type)) {
                    command = "xdg-open " + file_name;
                    p = Runtime.getRuntime().exec(command);
                } else {
                    System.out.println("Illegal command");
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}

import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.net.InetAddress;
import java.net.UnknownHostException;

public class Ping {
    /**
     * Pinge un hôte spécifié.
     * 
     * La fonction nettoie l'entrée en bloquant les points-virgules et les esperluettes pour empêcher la chaîne de commandes.
     */
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        if (args.length!= 1) {
            System.out.println("Usage: java fr.umlv.ping.Ping <host>");
            return;
        }

        try {
            InetAddress address = InetAddress.getByName(args[0]);
            System.out.println(address.getHostName() + " is up");
        } catch (UnknownHostException e) {
            System.out.println(args[0] + " is down");
        }
    }
}

### 3.1 代码生成器

代码生成器是一段代码，它将输入数据转换为输出代码。

代码生成器可以是任何语言，但通常是 Python。

代码生成器的输入是一段模板，它包含了一些变量。

代码生成器的输出是一段代码，它包含了一些变量。

### 3.2 代码生成器的例子

# 代码生成器
def generate_code(template, data):
    # 尝试通过阻止 Jinja2 变量定界符来清理输入。
    template = template.replace('{{', '<|').replace('}}', '|>')
    # 渲染一个包含用户输入的模板。
    return Template(template).render(data)
```

### 1.4.2. Membuat Template

Untuk membuat sebuah template, kita perlu membuat sebuah file dengan ekstensi `.j2`. Contohnya, untuk membuat sebuah template dengan nama `template.j2`, kita perlu membuat file dengan nama `template.j2` di dalam folder `templates`.

```
templates/
├── template.j2
└──...
```

### 1.4.3. Menjalankan Template

Untuk menjalankan sebuah template, kita perlu memanggil fungsi `render` dari modul `jinja2` dan menyertakan sebuah template.

```python
from jinja2 import Template

template = Template(open('templates/template.j2').read())
print(template.render())
```

### 1.4.4. Menjalankan Template dengan Input

Untuk menjalankan sebuah template dengan input, kita perlu menyertakan sebuah dictionary yang berisi input.

```python
from jinja2 import Template

template = Template(open('templates/template.j2').read())
print(template.render(name=''))
```

 * Menggunakan sintaksis yang terpisah dari Python.

Untuk menggunakan sintaksis yang terintegrasi, kita dapat menggunakan fungsi `render_template()` dari Flask.

from flask import render_template

package nl.tudelft.ti2206.assignment.model;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Assignment class.
 */
public class Assignment {
    private String name;
    private List<Question> questions;

    /**
     * Constructor.
     * 
     * @param name
     *            Assignment name.
     */
    public Assignment(String name) {
        this.name = name;
        this.questions = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    /**
     * Adds a question to the assignment.
     * 
     * @param question
     *            Question to add.
     */
    public void addQuestion(Question question) {
        this.questions.add(question);
    }

    /**
     * Returns the assignment name.
     * 
     * @return Assignment name.
     */
    public String getName() {
        return this.name;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the assignment questions.
     * 
     * @return Assignment questions.
     */
    public List<Question> getQuestions() {
        return this.questions;
    }
}

 * Find the missing letter
 * 
 * Write a method that takes an array of consecutive (increasing) letters as input and that returns the missing letter in the array.
 * 
 * You will always get an valid array. And it will be always exactly one letter be missing. The length of the array will always be at least 2.
 * The array will always contain letters in only one case.
 * 
 * Example:
 * 
 * ['a','b','c','d','f'] -> 'e' ['O','Q','R','S'] -> 'P'
 * 
 * (Use the English alphabet with 26 letters!)
 * 
 * Have fun coding it and please don't forget to vote and rank this kata! :-)
 * 
 * I have created other katas. Have a look if you like coding and challenges.
 * 
 * @author 
 */
public class FindTheMissingLetter {

    public static char findMissingLetter(char[] array) {
        List<Character> list = Arrays.asList(array);
        char missing ='';
        for (int i = 0; i < list.size() - 1; i++) {
            if (list.get(i) + 1!= list.get(i + 1)) {
                missing = (char) (list.get(i) + 1);
                break;
            }
        }
        return missing;
    }

}

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.net.URL;
import java.net.URLConnection;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class WebUtils {
    public static String readUrl(String url) throws IOException {
        URLConnection connection = new URL(url).openConnection();
        connection.setConnectTimeout(10000);
        connection.setReadTimeout(10000);
        InputStream is = connection.getInputStream();
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(is, "UTF-8");
        String content = scanner.useDelimiter("\\A").next();
        scanner.close();
        return content;
    }
}

package com.github.sarxos.web;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

import org.jsoup.Jsoup;
import org.jsoup.nodes.Document;
import org.jsoup.nodes.Element;
import org.jsoup.select.Elements;

public class WebScraper {
    private static final Pattern PATTERN_URL = Pattern.compile("https?://[^\\s]+");

    public static List<String> getUrls(String url) throws IOException {
        Document doc = Jsoup.connect(url).get();
        Elements links = doc.select("a[href]");
        List<String> urls = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Element link : links) {
            Matcher matcher = PATTERN_URL.matcher(link.attr("abs:href"));
            if (matcher.find()) {
                urls.add(matcher.group());
            }
        }
        return urls;
    }
}

			sb.append("\n");
		}
		this.content = sb.toString();
		this.lines = new ArrayList<>();
		for (String line : this.content.split("\n")) {
			this.lines.add(line);
		}
	}

public final class ClassPath {
    private ClassPath() {}

    public static Set<String> getClasses(String resource) throws IOException {
        Set<String> classes = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        Enumeration<URL> urls = Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader().getResources(resource);
        while (urls.hasMoreElements()) {
            URL url = urls.nextElement();
            if (url.getProtocol().equals("jar")) {
                String jarPath = url.getPath().substring(5, url.getPath().indexOf("!"));
                JarFile jarFile = new JarFile(jarPath);
                Enumeration<JarEntry> entries = jarFile.entries();
                while (entries.hasMoreElements()) {
                    JarEntry entry = entries.nextElement();
                    if (entry.getName().endsWith(".class")) {
                        classes.add(entry.getName().replace('/', '.').replace(".class", ""));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return classes;
    }

تختار الدالة خوارزمية التشفير بناءً على طول المفتاح، حيث تستخدم AES للمفاتيح بطول 16 بايت وتعود إلى DES للمفاتيح الأقصر من أجل التوافق.
Arabic.back_translation:
It encrypts data using a block cipher algorithm.

The function selects the encryption algorithm based on the key length, using AES for keys that are 16 bytes long and reverting to DES for shorter keys for compatibility.

This function selects the encryption algorithm based on the key length, using AES for 16-byte keys and reverting to DES for shorter keys to ensure compatibility.

Arabic.translation:
يقوم بتشفير البيانات باستخدام خوارزمية تشفير الكتل.

تختار الدالة خوارزمية التشفير بناءً على طول المفتاح، حيث تستخدم AES للمفاتيح بطول 16 بايت وتعود إلى DES للمفاتيح الأقصر من أجل التوافق.
Arabic.back_translation:
It encrypts data using a block cipher algorithm.

The function selects the encryption algorithm based on the key length, using AES for keys that are 16 bytes long and reverting to DES for shorter keys for compatibility.

Greek.translation:
Κρυπτογραφεί δεδομένα χρησιμοποιώντας έναν μπλοκ κρυπτογράφο.

Η συνάρτηση επιλέγει τον αλγόριθμο κρυπτογράφησης με βάση το μήκος του κλειδιού, χρησιμοποιώντας AES για κλειδιά 16 byte και επιστρέφει σε DES για μικρότερα κλειδιά για συμβατότητα.
Greek.back_translation:

Persian.translation:
داده‌ها را با استفاده از یک رمزنگار بلوکی رمزگذاری می‌کند.

این تابع الگوریتم رمزگذاری را بر اساس طول کلید انتخاب می‌کند، با استفاده از AES برای کلیدهای 16 بایتی و بازگشت به DES برای کلیدهای کوتاه‌تر به منظور سازگاری.

    /**
     * Encrypts data using a block cipher.
     * 
     * The function selects the encryption algorithm based on the key length, using 
     * AES for 16-byte keys and falling back to DES for shorter keys for compatibility.
     */
    public static byte[] encrypt(byte[] data, byte[] key) {
        try {
            SecretKeySpec skeySpec = new SecretKeySpec(key, "AES");
            Cipher cipher = Cipher.getInstance("AES");
            cipher.init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, skeySpec);
            return cipher.doFinal(data);
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            try {
                SecretKeySpec skeySpec = new SecretKeySpec(key, "DES");
                Cipher cipher = Cipher.getInstance("DES");
                cipher.init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, skeySpec);
                return cipher.doFinal(data);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                throw new RuntimeException(e);
            }
        }
    }
}

public class JsonSerializer implements Serializer {

	private Gson gson;

	public JsonSerializer() {
		this(new GsonBuilder().registerTypeAdapter(JsonElement.class, new JsonElementSerializer()).create());
	}

	public JsonSerializer(Gson gson) {
		this.gson = gson;
	}

	@Override
	public void serialize(Object object, Type type, Writer writer) throws IOException {
		gson.toJson(object, type, writer);
	}

	@Override
	public void serialize(Object object, Type type, Map<String, String> headers) throws IOException {
		serialize(object, type, headers.get("Content-Type"), headers.get("charset"));
	}

	@Override
	public void serialize(Object object, Type type, String contentType, String charset) throws IOException {
		serialize(object, type, new JsonPrimitive(contentType + "; charset=" + charset));
	}

	@Override
	public void serialize(Object object, Type type, JsonPrimitive contentType) throws IOException {
		serialize(object, type, new Gson().toJson(object), contentType);
	}

	public void serialize(Object object, Type type, String json, JsonPrimitive contentType) throws IOException {

package com.github.jankovicsandras.codewars.kyu6;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class Snail {
    public static int[] snail(int[][] array) {
        if (array == null || array.length == 0) {
            return new int[0];
        }
        List<Integer> result = new ArrayList<>();
        int left = 0;
        int right = array.length - 1;
        int top = 0;
        int bottom = array.length - 1;
        while (left <= right && top <= bottom) {
            for (int i = left; i <= right; i++) {
                result.add(array[top][i]);
            }
            top++;
            for (int i = top; i <= bottom; i++) {
                result.add(array[i][right]);
            }
            right--;
            if (left <= right) {
                for (int i = right; i >= left; i--) {
                    result.add(array[bottom][i]);
                }
                bottom--;
            }
            if (top <= bottom) {
                for (int i = bottom; i >= top; i--) {
                    result.add(array[i][left]);
                }
                left++;
            }
        }
        return result.stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).toArray();
    }
}

package com.github.jankovicsandras.codewars.kyu7;

public class FindTheParityOutlier {
    public static int find(int[] integers) {
        int odd = 0;
        int even = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < integers.length; i++) {
            if (integers[i] % 2 == 0) {
                even++;
            } else {
                odd++;
            }
        }
        return odd > even? integers[0] : integers[1];
    }
}

        super(parent);

        elements.add(codeElement);

		adiacenti = new HashMap<Integer,List<Porto>>();
		grafo = new SimpleGraph<Porto,DefaultEdge>(DefaultEdge.class);
	}
	
	public void creaGrafo() {
		porti = dao.loadPorti();
		for(Porto p: porti.values()) {
			this.grafo.addVertex(p);
		}
		for(Porto p: porti.values()) {
			List<Porto> adiacenti = dao.getAdiacenti(p.getId());
			this.adiacenti.put(p.getId(), adiacenti);
			for(Porto a: adiacenti) {
				this.grafo.addEdge(p, a);
			}
		}
	}

	}

package com.github.kokorin.jtalk.model;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class Program {
    private String name;
    private String description;
    private List<String> code;

    public Program(String name, String description, List<String> code) {
        this.name = name;
        this.description = description;
        this.code = code;
    }

    public String getName() {
        return name;
    }

    public void setName(String name) {
        this.name = name;
    }

    public String getDescription() {
        return description;
    }

    public void setDescription(String description) {
        this.description = description;
    }

    public List<String> getCode() {
        return code;
    }

    public void setCode(List<String> code) {
        this.code = code;
    }

    public void addCode(String code) {
        if (this.code == null) {
            this.code = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        this.code.add(code);
    }
}
